We are currently looking for an experienced Freelance Java Developer to join us in Brussels and take part in large-scale, impactful digital projects for one of our premium clients. 🏆
• Status: Freelance (Independent / Prestation de services)
• Location: Brussels, Belgium (Hybrid model: 2-3 days remote per week)
• Seniority Level: Medior (3+ years) to Senior (10+ years)
• Languages: Professional proficiency in either Dutch or French OR English
As a Freelance Java Developer, you will be integrated into a dynamic environment to design, develop, and maintain robust enterprise applications. Your main responsibilities will include:
• Designing and implementing high-quality software solutions using Java / Java EE technologies.
• Implementing and managing API and Web Services standards (OAuth2, OpenAPI, SOAP) and working within SOA / REST models.
• Translating business requirements into technical designs utilizing UML and BPMN.
• Collaborating within an Agile/Scrum methodology, while aligning with corporate governance frameworks (ITIL, PMBOK/PRINCE2).
• Contributing to architectural discussions and evolution using modern architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Archi, Sparx).
• Ensuring code quality, version control, and seamless integration using GIT and client frameworks (Axis 2, CXF, .Net compatibility).
• Experience: You have at least 3 years (Medior) to 10+ years (Senior) of proven experience in backend Java development.
• Core Tech Stack: Deep expertise in Java/Java EE, REST/SOA architectures, API security (OAuth2), and SOAP/OpenAPI standards.
• Methodologies: Strong familiarity with Agile/Scrum environments. Knowledge of ITIL, Prince2, or TOGAF is a major asset.
• Tools: Proficiency with GIT, UML/BPMN modeling tools (Sparx, Archi), and integration frameworks (Axis 2, CXF).
• Soft Skills: Autonomous, proactive, team-oriented, and solution-driven.
• Peer Management: Our proximity management by peers fosters dialogue and the implementation of a tailored career path.
• Continuous Learning: Because the digital sector is in constant motion, Smile is committed to making you an expert in your field, thanks to a comprehensive training offer: access to an e-learning platform, financing of certifications, and advanced knowledge-sharing tools.
• Vibrant Culture: Your year will be animated by group and agency events: annual convention, participation in trade fairs, summer party, and both formal & informal afterworks.
First contact: A phone call to discuss your aspirations, availability, and what we can offer you.
Meeting: An opportunity to get to know each other and explore your professional background.
Business interview: A deep-dive discussion with one of our experts to assess your technical skills and define your goals.
Are you ready to elevate your freelance career with Smile? Apply today!

Passionate about tech, digital, and innovation? Join the 1,800 employees at Smile, the European leader in open-source integration, spread across 20 agencies in 9 countries. Collaborative spirit and knowledge sharing are at the heart of our DNA.
